title: Ransomware and backups
body:
Ransomware encrypts your files and demands payment for the key. Paying does not guarantee you get the files back.

Defenders: keep tested, offline or immutable backups, patch quickly, filter malicious email and limit who can write to shared drives. A backup you never restored is only a hope.

How to spot it: files suddenly renamed with a new extension, a note demanding payment, or many files changing at once in the logs. Isolate the machine first, then restore from a backup you know is clean.
